evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/r contains no fields and one public static boolean helper. It branches on reward-container item names including Donator mystery box, Blood key, Grand blood key, Bond casket/key, Mystery crate/chest, event caskets/packages/crackers, pet boxes/chests and related reward containers.

Each recognized branch augments the displayed text with exact reward/rarity guidance and materializes an int[] of preview item IDs before dispatching the result through Client.a(int,int,String,int[]).

R207 proves Client.a(int,int,String,int[]) constructs TooltipContent (rs/l/f/a/j/a) and submits it to TooltipOverlay (rs/l/f/a/j/b); R213 proves the owning OverlayManager. rs/r therefore feeds reward-container-specific content into the canonical tooltip overlay subsystem.

The helper positions the tooltip from the live Client mouse coordinates with the exact interface offset adjustment, returns true after submitting a recognized reward-container tooltip, and returns false when no supported container name matched.

proposals.note: RewardContainerTooltipHandler is a descriptive exact-behavior name for the static utility that recognizes reward containers and submits reward-preview TooltipContent. It does not claim recovery of an original developer identifier.
